messages:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rates originating from KeyStream-managed cache in us-west-2 (KeyStream pool ks-prod-west-3). 5xx rate spiked to 18% for auth/token-cache keys.
incident-bot: Pager fired to #incidents: priority=page, runbook=https://runbooks/internal/keystream-fallback
infra-oncall-alex: I'm taking the page. seeing increased 'ERR maxclients' and connection timeouts on the KeyStream side in the dashboard.
sre-mei: thanks alex. do we know customer impact? prod-support-jon can you pull api error counts?
prod-support-jon: looking now — auth proxy 502s started ~10:22 UTC, users seeing intermittent login failures; per-customer impact seems concentrated on high-volume PLG customers in US-West. raising SEV2.
eng-runtime-lina: KeyStream HA appears to be rejecting new connections; metrics show connection_open_failures and a spike in latency for GET token:* keys. Possibly a connection pool exhaustion on their side.
infra-oncall-alex: trying to flip to local in-memory token fallback for auth service (no auth DB hit). executing emergency toggle:

POST https://admin.internal/api/v1/configs/feature-toggle
{
  "service": "auth-proxy",
  "feature": "keystream_token_fallback",
  "value": "on"
}

infra-oncall-alex: toggle accepted. restarting auth-proxy instances 4/6 to pick up config (rolling).
sre-mei: good. also can we temporarily relax rate limiter to reduce cache hammering? suggestion: increase token bucket capacity from 100->300 for auth-proxy for 15m.
eng-runtime-lina: submitting change to rate-limiter-service -> patch and apply: 15m window. command: `kubectl apply -f rate-limiter-keystream-fallover.yaml` (I pushed the manifest).
prod-support-jon: after toggle, 502 rate dropped from 18% -> ~6% in 90s. visible improvement for impacted customers but still not normal.
pm-erin: heads-up to customers on status page? we should post a short note describing degraded login behavior and that mitigation in progress.
prod-support-jon: posting now: "We are investigating intermittent login failures affecting some users in US-West. Mitigation underway; updates in 30 mins."
sre-mei: reached out to KeyStream support (ticket #KS-78412). they reported a control plane rolling restart causing transient connection errors and are throttling new connections. asked for ETA.
eng-runtime-lina: as a precaution I'm enabling local LRU cache for 60s TTL to reduce upstream reads: env var AUTH_LOCAL_CACHE_TTL=60, AUTH_LOCAL_CACHE_ENABLED=true. applied to canary first.
infra-oncall-alex: canary shows reduced calls to KeyStream by ~70% and auth success rate improved. proceeding with batch rollout.
incident-bot: NOTE: please document exact timeline + commands in the incident doc per runbook.
prod-support-jon: customer impact estimated: ~12 customers experienced >5% error rates, two enterprise customers had short login outages but auto-recovered after fallback. no data loss.
sre-mei: KeyStream support says they expect connections to stabilize in ~25 minutes after draining.
eng-runtime-lina: plan: keep local fallback + relaxed rate limits for 30m, then gradually revert once KeyStream stable.
infra-oncall-alex: escalating to oncall-next for handoff. @oncall-next-tom you're up for the 12:30 UTC -> 16:30 UTC window, jumping in now with notes.
oncall-next-tom: acknowledged. please leave me the exact commands and the manifest diff.
infra-oncall-alex: pasted manifest link + commands into the thread: https://internal/repos/ops/keystream-failover/changeset/234
sre-mei: postmortem pointers: capture why we didn't prefer local fallback earlier, check our connection pool sizing for KeyStream, and validate client-side retry/backoff semantics.
pm-erin: I'll draft a customer-facing follow-up once incident is closed.
prod-support-jon: final check: error rate stabilized at ~1.2% after full rollout and KeyStream reported connection drains finishing.
infra-oncall-alex: marking incident as mitigated. still in monitoring for 60m. switching Slack channel to #incidents-postmortem for writeup.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated. Please run the post-incident checklist: https://runbooks/internal/post-incident-checklist and assign a P0 postmortem within 48h.
sre-mei: assigned postmortem to eng-runtime-lina and infra-oncall-alex.
oncall-next-tom: handoff complete. I'm on watch.
prod-support-jon: posting final customer update: "Issue mitigated; temporary fallback used to reduce login errors. We'll follow up with details and timeline."
